title: Design register (parsed from spec/designs.csv)
description: One row per DESIGN, not per estimator. Estimator choice never moves a design up a tier — two-way fixed effects, Callaway-Sant'Anna and Sun-Abraham are estimator options of the one DiD design, not three designs.

estimator_options.description: Pipe-separated in the CSV, parsed to an array.

tier_qualifier.description: Where a design sits at an edge of its tier, e.g. matching with prior-outcome controls as upper Tier 4.
